scope.flow: redelegateWithdrawnHYPE re-delegation of cancelled withdrawal amounts through _distributeStake with SpotDeposit

entities.name: _cancelledWithdrawalAmount recorded from cancelled withdrawal HYPE value

statements.text: A user cancels a withdrawal request via cancelWithdrawal, recording the associated HYPE value (totalHypeValueReturned) in _cancelledWithdrawalAmount.
An account with MANAGER_ROLE privileges calls redelegateWithdrawnHYPE.
redelegateWithdrawnHYPE reads _cancelledWithdrawalAmount, resets it to zero, and re-delegates the HYPE amount via _distributeStake with OperationType.SpotDeposit.
_distributeStake for SpotDeposit calls _convertTo8Decimals(amount, false), computing truncatedAmount = amount / 1e10 with roundUp false (always rounding down).

Unlike UserDeposit handling, the SpotDeposit/RebalanceDeposit conversion does not account for the remainder amount % 1e10; the remainder is neither added back to hypeBuffer nor included in the truncatedAmount sent to L1.

Each redelegateWithdrawnHYPE re-delegation loses _cancelledWithdrawalAmount % 1e10 HYPE (less than 1e10 wei, i.e. less than 1e-8 HYPE) from the re-delegation process due to rounding down without remainder handling.

The lost HYPE remains within the StakingManager contract but falls outside normal accounting: it is neither recorded in totalStaked, explicitly tracked in hypeBuffer, nor delegated to validators to generate rewards.
As cancel-and-redelegate operations accumulate, the lost HYPE grows and becomes permanently stranded in the StakingManager contract, unusable by the protocol or returnable to users.
The stranding reduces the protocol's capital efficiency and directly diminishes the potential profits for all kHYPE holders.

Re-delegating a cancelled withdrawal amount should preserve the full HYPE value: any sub-1e10 remainder from 8-decimal conversion should be retained in hypeBuffer or otherwise accounted for, not dropped from accounting and delegation.
Only accounts holding MANAGER_ROLE can invoke redelegateWithdrawnHYPE.

ambiguities: Report does not state whether the remainder is stranded in the contract's ETH balance or an L1 account; it says 'possibly' depending on fund flow implementation.
No concrete numeric amount of _cancelledWithdrawalAmount or accumulated loss is given.
Whether the lost HYPE is truly unrecoverable (permanent) is asserted as a claim, not demonstrated by a concrete transaction.
